verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter is an immigration law firm whose product is attorney-delivered legal services: petitions, visa strategy and compliance help. Reading the product's source code under an open license is a category error for a professional services firm. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships software whose source could be published; the client portal is only mentioned as a service channel.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
